'''Hal''' was the [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] of the [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]] [[Resurgence (Curich-class)|''Resurgence'']].<ref name="Godking" /> He had served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gorgi]] for over a [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. Hal was extremely loyal to his captain, even going so far as to follow his orders over [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Dixton]]'s. A heavyset man, Hal carried an assortment of tools with him that he used to repair [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Godking-CC">{{WEGCite|book=Classic Campaigns|story=Tests of the Godking}}</ref>
